sources.note: Main homepage. Cloud-based EHR and RCM platform for medical practices. Based in Longwood, FL. Tagline 'We care.' Testimonials reference cardiology, spine care, primary care, diagnostic centers.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists ONC certification #15.05.05.2163.PEMR.01.00.1.200123, 12 CQMs, EMR Direct Interoperability Engine 2017, pricing models (monthly subscription or license purchase), 1-year contract terms.
EHR feature page. Describes CPOE, e-prescribing, patient portal, task management, document management, in-app eligibility verification, RCM services, HIPAA compliance.
Medical billing page. Describes coding, charge entry, claim submission (24hr turnaround, 99% accuracy claimed), rejection management, payment posting. Positions as outsourced billing service.
Services overview page. Lists 10+ services: credentialing, medical billing, e-scribe, authorization, scheduling, documentation, transcription, AR management, digital marketing, medical assistance.
E-Scribe service page. Virtual scribe service for ED and clinical documentation. Handles patient history, physical exam findings, procedures, clinical notes, assessment/plans.
Scheduling page. Appointment scheduling with provider availability matching, reminders, cancellation list management, test scheduling, call routing.

Medical documentation page. Describes transcription, record retrieval, ROI processing, fax management, remote patient monitoring (cardiac devices, weight scales, BP monitors). Oddly mentions 'EpicCare' — may reflect cross-facility scribe services.
Pricing page. No specific prices shown; directs to contact/demo. Lists all service categories available.

LinkedIn company page. Founded 2013, 51-200 employees, privately held, ~300 followers. Founding members have 20+ years combined healthcare/IT experience. Describes as 'cloud-based communications platform for healthcare professionals.'

Heart Experts of Florida website — cardiology practice of Dr. Wasim Ahmar (IPClinical founder/contact). Same address as IPClinical (450 W SR-434, Longwood FL). Confirms founder is a practicing cardiologist with 30+ years experience.
Healthgrades profile for Dr. Wasim Ahmar — cardiologist in Longwood FL, confirming the physician-founder background.
